text.arabic_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ

words.gloss_range: interrogated reckoning, supposing, or calculating; the local verb makes the human's thought a challengeable proposition rather than neutral psychology
words.root_gloss_range: reckoning, counting, supposing, accounting, sufficiency, and related accountability branches; the local form selects mental reckoning while account/audit pressure remains relevant
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَحْسَبُ}} ({{tr:a-yaḥsabu}}) opens with the question attached to the reckoning verb, so the human's inner calculation is put on trial from the first word. The verb does not merely report a mental state; it governs the whole following content clause, turning the boast into a proposition that can be tested. Its hidden third-person subject carries the human from 90:4 into this ayah, while the {{ar:ح س ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-s-b}}) field makes the supposition feel like a self-account exposed to counter-reckoning. The simple Form I keeps the estimate unilateral, as if no counter-account has been admitted, and the recorded vowel variant changes recitational color without changing the same interrogated reckoning frame. The same opening formula returns in 90:7, and the wider human-delusion echo with 75:36 keeps this local claim about power inside a broader pattern of imagined immunity; the two imperfect verbs also make the calculating act move audibly toward the denied power act.

topics.headline: question turns private reckoning into rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not neutrally report a thought; it opens by challenging the thought as answerable.
topics.reason: QAC marks the prefixed interrogative hamza on the Form I imperfect, and attachment evidence identifies the surface force as a rhetorical-question candidate.

topics.headline: reckoning governs a whole proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that arrogance is formulated as a testable embedded claim, not as an isolated feeling or vague attitude.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the following content clause the syntactically forced complement of the cognition verb, and the contextual valency profile confirms that clausal complements are ordinary for this form.

topics.headline: hidden subject carries the prior human forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same human from being created in hardship in 90:4 into becoming the one who now calculates immunity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies a third-person masculine singular implicit subject with the prior singular human as the licensed discourse candidate.

topics.headline: supposition feels like an account awaiting audit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the false supposition as a kind of self-accounting that can be measured and overturned, not merely as a passing opinion.
topics.reason: V4 supports both reckoning/counting and supposition branches for {{ar:ح س ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-s-b}}); local grammar selects the cognition verb, while the accounting field remains a live lexical pressure.

topics.headline: Form I keeps the estimate unilateral
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word portrays the human making a one-sided estimate, while accountability and sufficiency branches expose what his estimate wrongly excludes.
topics.reason: The surface is a simple Form I imperfect, so derived reciprocal, causative, sufficiency, and judicial accounting forms cannot replace the local sense, but they clarify the background pressure.

topics.headline: vowel variant preserves the same challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register a recitational color difference without losing the same root, person, aspect, and interrogated reckoning frame.
topics.reason: The reported vowel variation changes stem coloring while preserving the interrogative Form I imperfect analysis.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this opening as part of a recurring challenge formula: it returns in 90:7 and narrows the broader human unaccountability question in 75:36.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references, and the local syntax supports the same opening cognition-plus-content frame.

topics.headline: two imperfect verbs sound paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the calculating act move toward the denied capacity act as the proposition unfolds.
topics.reason: Both major verbs are imperfects in the local word table, and the semantic pairing of reckoning with measuring capacity is supported by the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: creation statement becomes interrogated self-estimate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the movement from the prior statement of human condition into a direct prosecution of the human's response.
topics.reason: The rhetorical question and the implicit subject link the new ayah to the preceding human referent while changing the discourse mode.

words.gloss_range: governed content complementizer introducing what the human reckons; not purposive here
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) is the hinge that turns the rest of the ayah into the content of the false reckoning. After the cognition verb, it does not mean purpose; it encloses the coming future denial as what he thinks. Its contact with the following negator makes the complement and negation feel compressed in recitation, so the boast is both grammatically bounded and tightly sounded. The same proposition-framing role returns in the matched rebuke of 90:7.

topics.headline: particle turns denial into thought content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not free-standing; it is the exact proposition being challenged inside the reckoning verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following words as a governed content complement of the opening cognition verb.

topics.headline: governor blocks a purpose reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the clause as what he thinks, not why he acts.
topics.reason: The local governor is the cognition verb, so the valid local role is content-complement marking rather than an independent purpose clause.

topics.headline: scope encloses the whole remaining ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every later element, negator, capacity verb, target, and final subject, as part of one bounded arrogance-claim.
topics.reason: The attachment clause spans words 2 through 6 as the content complement.

topics.headline: assimilation tightens complement and negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the complementizer and future negator arrive as a tight unit while the grammar remains analyzable.
topics.reason: The source rows tie the recitational assimilation to the actual adjacent particle sequence.

topics.headline: same proposition frame returns in 90:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the particle as part of the repeated 90:5 and 90:7 rebuke frame, where each accusation is cast as an interrogated proposition.
topics.reason: The row gives the concrete same-surah recurrence, and the local attachment evidence confirms the same content-clause function here.

words.gloss_range: future-oriented negation inside the embedded claim, governing the subjunctive capacity verb and projecting the boast forward
words.prose: {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) turns the claim into a future denial: the human is not just misreading the present but forecasting that no power-over-him relation will ever arrive. It governs the following subjunctive verb, so the denied capacity remains trapped inside the challenged proposition. With the final indefinite subject, the negation becomes totalizing without becoming grammatically loose: not even one possible agent is admitted. Its doubled sound and the {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}})-to-{{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) compression make the boast feel tight and emphatic, while the parallel frame in 21:87 shows a recognizable constraint construction being repurposed here for human arrogance. Against the prior statement of human pressure in 90:4, the particle makes the boast a reckless forecast that no future constraining power can ever bear on him.

topics.headline: future negation exposes overconfident forecast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boast reaches forward into all coming circumstances, not merely into the present moment.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) as the negative future particle scoped inside the embedded content clause.

topics.headline: particle governs the capacity verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the capacity relation as syntactically dependent on the negator, not as an independent assertion.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence says {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) governs the following subjunctive verb.

topics.headline: negation plus final indefinite totalizes the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denial widen to exclude any possible agent while still being built from ordinary clause grammar.
topics.reason: The negator governs the predicate through the delayed indefinite subject at the end of the embedded clause.

topics.headline: doubled sound tightens the negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the claim's future denial as compressed and emphatic at the exact particle where the boast turns negative.
topics.reason: The source rows tie the shaddah and assimilation to the adjacent complementizer-negator sequence.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that a known an-lan-q-d-r-over constraint frame (21:87) is placed here inside arrogant human reckoning.
topics.reason: The row supplies the concrete reference and the local syntax contains the same particle-plus-capacity-over pattern.

topics.headline: prior pressure is answered by future denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the absurdity of a human created in pressure imagining a future with no constraining power over him.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the prior human condition with the projected negation, and V4 supports the capacity and measure field of the following predicate.

words.gloss_range: to have effective capacity or power over a target, with measure, constraint, and limit-setting pressure active through the local over-phrase
words.root_gloss_range: measure, extent, determining, capacity, mastery, restriction, proportion, and unrelated pot/cooking branches; the local construction selects capacity-over with measure-and-constraint pressure, not every branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: future negator governing the subjunctive capacity verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَقْدِرَ}} ({{tr:yaqdira}}) is the correction point inside the embedded claim. In the local over-phrase, capacity is directed against a target, so the issue is not abstract ability but power that can bear on the human and set limits. The verb is subjunctive under {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}), which keeps that capacity as the very possibility the boast denies, while its active voice leaves room for the final subject to enter as the denied possible agent. Its Form I shape matters: the human denies even simple effective capacity over him, while the wider {{ar:ق د ر}} ({{tr:q-d-r}}) field lets power and measurement answer the false self-reckoning of {{ar:أَيَحْسَبُ}} ({{tr:a-yaḥsabu}}). Because the predicate comes before the delayed final subject, the reader hears power-over-him before hearing how universal the denied agent field is. The same capacity-over frame in 21:87 and the paired shift from power to seeing in 90:7 keep this verb inside a wider exposure pattern; its firmer sound texture supports the move from internal calculation to external constraint, and the prior hardship frame makes denial of any limiting power incoherent.

topics.headline: capacity is framed as power over him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb names directed power over a target, not vague or abstract ability.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following prepositional phrase the complement of {{ar:يَقْدِرَ}} ({{tr:yaqdira}}), and contextual evidence shows the over-preposition as the top local profile for this form.

topics.headline: subjunctive keeps capacity inside denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the power relation as a prospective denied possibility, not as an event independently asserted by the ayah.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as subjunctive after {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}), and attachment evidence gives the particle-complement relation.

topics.headline: power relation arrives before the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader confronts the power-over-him predicate before the final word reveals that the denial extends to any possible subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the final noun as delayed subject, so the verb and target phrase are heard before the agent field.

topics.headline: active voice preserves possible agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the claim deny a possible agent's exercise of capacity rather than merely describe the human as constrained.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as active, and the clause supplies an overt delayed subject.

topics.headline: capacity carries measure and limit-setting pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denied power as the capacity to measure, determine, and set real limits over the self-reckoner.
topics.reason: V4 supports measure, determining, capacity, and restriction branches for {{ar:ق د ر}} ({{tr:q-d-r}}); the local construction selects capacity-over while preserving measure and constraint pressure.

topics.headline: Form I denies even simple capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boast is broader than denying intensified mastery; it denies even bare effective ability over him.
topics.reason: The surface form is Form I, so causative, intensified, and explicit determination forms do not replace the local verb, but they clarify how broad the denied capacity is.

topics.headline: capacity frame joins nearby and cross-ayah patterns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this predicate connect to the paired 90:7 exposure of seeing, to a q-d-r plus any-one field, and to the constraint frame in 21:87.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references, and the local phrase contains the capacity-over construction needed for the comparison.

topics.headline: human reckoning meets measuring capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two imperfect verbs pair the human's calculation with the denied possibility of real power and measure.
topics.reason: Both verbs are imperfects in the word table, and V4 supports the relevant reckoning and measure-capacity root fields.

topics.headline: sound hardens the shift to constraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a firmer sound texture as the ayah moves from internal calculation to external constraint.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the actual local capacity verb.

topics.headline: hardship and measured creation hand off to denied capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial of power over him as incoherent against the prior picture of a human already formed and pressured within limits.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the prior human condition to the current predicate, and the predicate is the core of the embedded denial.

words.gloss_range: over him, upon him, or against him as the governed target phrase of the capacity verb, carrying authority and pressure over the prior human
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) is where the denied capacity becomes directed and personal. The phrase completes the verb as power over him, not ability in general, and the suffix carries the human from 90:4 into the target position. That role reversal matters: the one who calculates in the opening verb becomes the one over whom power may bear. The preposition keeps overness, authority, burden, and pressure together, and the local capacity-over-him phrase reinforces a constraint-over-target construction rather than a free-floating power claim. The word order places the human's exposure before the final agent field opens, and the breath-to-hamza boundary lets the ear mark the turn from exposed target to possible agent.

topics.headline: prepositional phrase targets the capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause denies power specifically over him, not capacity in the abstract.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the complement of the capacity verb, and contextual profiles show the over-preposition as the dominant profile for the verb form.

topics.headline: suffix retrieves the prior human
topics.reader_payoff: The reader carries the same human from 90:4 into the current claim, rather than treating the pronoun as a new or vague target.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the masculine singular suffix as resuming the previous singular human referent.

topics.headline: thinker becomes exposed target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the human's self-image inverted: the calculating subject is grammatically made the object over whom power may bear.
topics.reason: The same discourse referent is the implicit subject of the opening verb and the suffix target of the capacity phrase.

topics.headline: overness makes authority feel like pressure

topics.reason: The over-preposition is locally governed by the capacity verb; its broader overness and pressure values color the relation without becoming independent topics.

topics.headline: surface fuses overness with the target before the agent

topics.reason: The written word combines the preposition and suffix, and word order places it before the delayed subject.

topics.headline: phrase reinforces constraint-over-target language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local capacity-over-him phrase as part of a constraint-over-target construction rather than a free-floating power claim.
topics.reason: The local construction matches the q-d-r plus over-preposition constraint pattern supported in the dictionary evidence.

topics.headline: sound boundary separates target from agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition from exposed target to unnamed possible agent at the word boundary.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the immediate transition from this word to the final subject.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative one or anyone under negation, functioning as the delayed subject and widening the claim to not a single possible agent
words.root_gloss_range: one-ness, singleness, uniqueness, and polarity-sensitive anyone; V4 root rows are missing, so local grammar and contextual evidence constrain the word to indefinite singular anyone under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: future negator under whose scope the final indefinite stands

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدٌۭ}} ({{tr:aḥadun}}) closes the ayah by finally supplying the subject of the capacity verb: a number-like noun becomes the agent slot of the denied power relation. Because it is indefinite and under {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}), one-ness widens into anyone: the boast must exclude not a named opponent but every possible single agent, one by one, rather than a vague plural class. Its final position makes the claim sound largest exactly at closure, while the tanwīn leaves the agent unnamed and open. The final singular also answers the prior singular target: one exposed self is set against any possible one who could overpower him. The same final noun returns in 90:7, pairing denial of power with denial of witness, and the contrast with 112:1 exposes a human fantasy of practical unanswerability without turning this indefinite word into a divine-title claim. The hamza onset makes the final agent field enter sharply, and the open-ended hardship of 90:4 makes this open-ended denial of any agent sound especially fragile.

topics.headline: final noun supplies the agent-subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits until the final word to learn who is being denied as the possible agent of power.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the delayed nominative subject of the capacity verb.

topics.headline: indefinite one becomes anyone under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boast widen from no known opponent to not a single possible agent.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as indefinite and nominative, and contextual evidence identifies this form as strongly negative-polarity in distribution.

topics.headline: singleness drives exhaustive exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is achieved by excluding each possible one individually, not by using a vague plural.
topics.reason: The local word is singular, indefinite, and under negative scope, so the one-ness pressure is grammatically converted into exhaustive polarity.

topics.headline: number-word carries agenthood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a number-like noun fill the agent slot of the denied power relation.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as NOUN_NUM while attachment evidence makes it the subject.

topics.headline: tanwīn leaves the agent unnamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an unnamed open agent field rather than a named adversary.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite with tanwīn, supporting an open rather than specified subject.

topics.headline: final position makes the claim land broadly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the claim reach maximum breadth at the ayah's last word.
topics.reason: The word is the delayed subject and final word of the ayah, so closure coincides with the universalized agent field.

topics.headline: same final noun closes the paired rebukes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 90:5 and 90:7 close on the same universalizing noun, pairing imagined immunity from power with imagined immunity from being seen.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete same-surah recurrence, and the local word occupies the same closure role in this ayah.

topics.headline: contrast with 112:1 exposes practical unanswerability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrast between divine absolute uniqueness in 112:1 and the human fantasy here of no one being able to answer him.
topics.reason: The contrast is valid as an inter-ayah lexical pressure, while local grammar keeps this word indefinite under negation rather than a divine-title assertion.

topics.headline: one exposed self faces any one agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the singular target in the prior word answered by a singular open agent field at the end.
topics.reason: The preceding suffix marks one human target, and the final indefinite singular noun opens the agent field one possible subject at a time.

topics.headline: hamza introduces the final agent field sharply

topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the actual word boundary before the final noun.

topics.reason: The boundary row links the prior condition with the final indefinite denial, and the local word is indeed indefinite under negative scope.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative أَيَحْسَبُ joins a mental estimate to the exhaustive negative لَّن ... أَحَدٌ around the relation عَلَيْهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A provisional supposition is inflated into universal immunity: the subject treats the absence of every possible effective controller as settled.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning as supposition supplies the insecure mental premise that the question exposes.
Capacity reaching effective control gives the denied predicate its force of mastery over the subject.
Exhaustive anyone under negation turns a local confidence into a claim of exception from every agent.

changed_reading.before: A neutral question asks whether another person is stronger than him.
changed_reading.after: The question diagnoses a fragile inner guess that has been overextended into total impunity from every effective agent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered roots ح س ب، ق د ر، ء ح د can be heard as count, measure, and one while remaining attached to يَحْسَبُ، يَقْدِرَ، and أَحَدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause forms a compact accounting chain: one who counts concludes that no single counter can measure his extent. The challenged error is not only overconfidence in force but the fantasy of being unassessable.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning opens a ledger-like rather than merely psychological register.
Measure reaching a thing's limit makes the denied act an assessment or delimitation of his extent.
One in counting supplies the smallest counter whose supposed inability is generalized.

changed_reading.before: He thinks no one can overpower him.
changed_reading.after: He calculates that no counter can measure, delimit, or close the account on him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb يَقْدِرَ is followed by عَلَيْهِ, a construction compatible with the root's branch of narrowing something to a scant measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The boast denies susceptibility to imposed limits: no one, he supposes, can narrow his room, means, or provision. Power and constriction remain live together.

activation_trace.role: Supposition marks unconstricted existence as his projection rather than an established condition.
Narrowing to a scant measure turns mastery over him into the capacity to restrict what is open or abundant.
Exhaustive negation makes him imagine that no possible source of constraint exists.

changed_reading.before: The issue is defeat by a stronger opponent.
changed_reading.after: The issue is his imagined exemption from every narrowing limit, including restriction of means.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The supposition verb carries neighboring branches of enoughness and counted social merit, while أَحَدٌ can isolate the individual challenger.
baseline_models.mechanism: He may be mentally converting sufficiency or social standing into a shield: what he counts as his worth is assumed to make every separate claimant ineffective.

activation_trace.role: Enoughness supplies the fantasy that his own resources remove dependence on anyone else.
Counted merits and social standing make prestige a possible mechanism of insulation.
Effective control names what his presumed status is imagined to block.
Individual-by-individual isolation pictures each possible challenger as too atomized to reach him.

changed_reading.before: He simply overestimates his bodily strength.
changed_reading.after: He mistakes accumulated means and counted standing for social immunity from every individual claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots in يَحْسَبُ and يَقْدِرَ also offer accountable supervision and deliberative arrangement without leaving the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denied power can be administrative or judicial: he imagines that nobody can inspect, order, and take his case in hand.

activation_trace.role: Supervision and practical accountability make reckoning an act performed upon conduct.
Arrangement by estimate and deliberation supplies the taking-in-hand of an affair.
Exhaustive anyone makes the imagined absence of an auditor or manager categorical.

changed_reading.before: No one can physically dominate him.
changed_reading.after: No one, he imagines, can investigate, administer, or bring his affair under accountable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Allotment, a bounded territory, and the undoing of a prohibition turn the focus limit into jurisdiction: the supposedly unreachable man is already situated inside divided space and changing legal states.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure is the focus-side possibility of being placed under a boundary.
Accountable supervision lets bounded space function as an administered domain.
Separating shares and dividing a thing supplies an ordered partition rather than limitless space.
A delimited place on earth locates the addressee inside a finite domain.
The repeated delimited place keeps that boundary active while the addressee's status is foregrounded.
The dissolution of a ban supplies a legal state whose limits can be imposed or removed.

structural_cues: 90:1-2 repeat the same البلد while shifting from oath framing to the addressee's condition within it.
The focus relation عَلَيْهِ can carry imposed authority or constraint alongside physical force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, bounded place, and release from prohibition; I infer that these make a jurisdiction capable of limiting him. A live alternative is that they frame location and sanctity without specifying an authority relation.

changed_reading.before: He denies that an opponent can overpower him.
changed_reading.after: He imagines that no authority can delimit him, although he is already inside apportioned, bounded, and norm-governed space.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation from another, creation by measure, and existence inside hardship make unlimited self-authorship impossible. The one who claims to be beyond measure is himself a measured outcome.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching an extent makes measurability the focus-side target of the boast.
Counting turns his claim into a calculation contradicted by his own measured origin.
Something arising from another supplies derivation and dependence rather than self-origin.
Creating as estimating and measuring directly cross-activates the focus branch of measured extent.
Hardship and struggle place the measured creature inside resistance he does not control.

structural_cues: Parent and offspring in 90:3 lead directly into the creation of the human in 90:4, immediately before the focus question.
The first-person plural creator in 90:4 contrasts with the singular human's claim of immunity in 90:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivation, measured creation, and hardship; I infer the irony that a measured creature claims no one can measure or limit him. The alternative keeps يقدر strictly at effective power while using creation only to identify the superior agent.

changed_reading.before: The human imagines that no external force can master him.
changed_reading.after: A generated and proportioned human imagines himself beyond the very measure and resistance that constitute his existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse supplies a spoken expenditure claim denominated in piled wealth. That claim turns the focus reckoning into a self-authored ledger whose spectacular outflow is being used as proof of immunity from audit.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting make the focus question capable of auditing the following boast.
Measured amount makes his claimed expenditure assessable rather than rhetorically boundless.
An uttered statement turns inward supposition into an externally inspectable boast.
Exhaustion and depletion give the boast the form of claimed resource outflow.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the stock from which the speaker claims to spend.
A mass piled layer upon layer makes abundance materially countable despite its boastful scale.

structural_cues: 90:6 immediately follows the focus with first-person reported speech and a quantified object of expenditure.
The movement from private يَحْسَبُ to public يَقُولُ externalizes the calculation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, depletion, wealth, and piled mass; I infer that the expenditure claim functions as a self-issued receipt meant to deter audit. It could alternatively be sheer bragging without a bookkeeping strategy.

changed_reading.before: He thinks nobody can defeat him.
changed_reading.after: He thinks his own account of immense spending is beyond measurement, verification, and accountable control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated frame substitutes seeing for having power. This creates an abductive chain in which presumed invisibility licenses presumed impunity: if no witness saw the act, he reasons, no agent can effectively act upon him.

activation_trace.role: Practical accountability supplies the enforcement function whose informational basis is tested by the parallel verse.
Capacity reaching effective control is re-read as enforceability rather than raw strength.
Exhaustive anyone establishes the universal absence of an enforcer that the speaker imagines.
The repeated supposition marks unseen action and untouchability as two linked beliefs.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the missing observation on which his theory of non-enforcement depends.
The same exhaustive anyone seals the syntactic parallel between absent controller and absent witness.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 share أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّـ... أَحَدٌ while the middle predicate changes from power to sight.
90:6, the boastful deed-report, stands between the paired questions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-identical frames and the sight predicate; I supply the arrow from observation to enforceable accountability. A live alternative is that power and sight are separate accusations intensified only by repetition.

changed_reading.before: He believes no agent has enough power to master him.
changed_reading.after: He believes an unseen act is unenforceable, so lack of a witness is converted into lack of anyone able to call him to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Made eyes, communicative organs, and manifest routes turn the subject's own body and orientation into evidence infrastructure. His capacity is granted, and the means of seeing, reporting, and choosing accompany him.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and testing information makes the focus supposition vulnerable to embodied evidence.
Effective capacity is revised from autonomous possession to an ability whose instruments were supplied.
Making and producing supplies the external origin of the faculties on which his agency depends.
The eye of care and supervision makes sight an organ of watchfulness as well as reception.
Conveying a message makes the tongue a channel by which hidden conduct can become report.
Speech passing from lip to lip supplies interpersonal transmission rather than sealed privacy.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies disclosed orientation and accountable choice.
Manifest appearance makes the two routes legible rather than hidden.

structural_cues: 90:8-10 enumerate paired organs and then paired paths after the question about being seen.
The repeated benefactive pronoun in the bodily endowment sequence identifies the same human as recipient rather than self-source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made faculties, communication, guidance, and manifest routes; I infer that they form evidence and agency infrastructure that defeats autonomous impunity. Alternatively, they may establish gratitude and choice without implying self-witness or report.

changed_reading.before: His power is an autonomous possession and secrecy protects its use.
changed_reading.after: His very capacity and the channels that can disclose its use are endowed, embodied, and oriented toward visible alternatives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question of who can act upon him is reversed into what he can bring himself to do. He projects power outward, yet the sequence tests capacity by a hard ascent and specifies its use as releasing another person from enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity is the focus hinge that can reverse from domination suffered to agency exercised.
Perilous difficulties of a route materialize the demanding action his claimed power does not perform.
The difficult rising obstacle gives capacity a resistant object rather than a victim.
Knowledge and discernment interrupt the speaker's self-sufficient estimate by requiring disclosed understanding.
Releasing a pledge or neck from enclosure redirects effective power toward liberation.
The neck makes the object of release a concrete embodied person under another's power.

structural_cues: The failed-action form in 90:11 follows the endowment of faculties and paths.
90:12 repeats the obstacle as a question, and 90:13 answers with an act that removes constraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hard passage, a knowledge challenge, and release from bondage; I infer a reversal from boasting about immunity to failing a test of liberating agency. The alternative is a simpler contrast between arrogance and a separately prescribed good deed.

changed_reading.before: Power means preventing anyone from acting over him.
changed_reading.after: Power is tested by whether he can cross resistance and use capacity to remove power from over someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding amid famine identifies isolated and abased persons whose need can bear upon accumulated wealth. The exhaustive 'anyone' becomes concrete: each vulnerable person can constitute a moral claim عَلَيْهِ, and meeting that claim narrows his surplus.

activation_trace.role: Practical accountability lets another person's need become an inspectable claim on conduct.
Narrowing provision gives the claimant's demand a real cost to the speaker's abundance.
Isolation individual by individual prepares the shift from abstract nobody to each socially isolated person.
Feeding another turns wealth into an outward transfer answering embodied need.
A day's severe event makes the obligation situationally urgent rather than abstract.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the bodily pressure exerted by unmet need.
A child cut off from a maintainer identifies a claimant whose dependence lacks its expected support.
Kinship makes the supposedly powerless individual's claim socially near and relationally specific.
The abasement of destitution supplies a person stripped of ordinary leverage yet still morally pressing.
Poverty as adhesion to dust locates the claimant at the material floor of the speaker's piled wealth.

structural_cues: The release-or-feeding alternatives in 90:13-16 convert the earlier wealth boast into named uses of resources.
The beneficiaries move from a related orphan to an abject poor person, widening the reach of أَحَدٌ while keeping each person concrete.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly aid, hunger, isolation, kinship, and poverty; I infer that these persons exert a moral due 'upon him' even without coercive strength. A live alternative is that the verses commend aid without making the beneficiaries grammatical claimants in 90:5.

changed_reading.before: No person is powerful enough to impose anything on him.
changed_reading.after: He supposes that not even one vulnerable person can have a binding claim upon him or reduce his hoarded surplus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Becoming part of a trusting group that exchanges counsel, bears responsibility, and practices mercy replaces the isolated sovereign self with reciprocal formation. Other people legitimately act upon him and are sustained by him.

activation_trace.role: Isolation and individual distribution expose the atomized social picture inside his claim of nobody over him.
Accountable management gives reciprocal counsel a focus-anchored alternative to unanswerable autonomy.
Sponsorship and standing over another supplies responsibility as a mode of belonging.
Settled trust supplies the relational security in which mutual influence need not be domination.
Exchanged counsel among a group directly supplies reciprocal action person upon person.
Bearing responsibility and remaining attached give mutual counsel durable social force.
Tender mercy directs reciprocal power toward care rather than mastery.

structural_cues: The reciprocal verb تَوَاصَوْا is repeated with patience and mercy as its two contents.
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ marks a transition from the singular boaster into membership among others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group membership, trust, reciprocal counsel, endurance, and mercy; I infer a social answer to the fantasy that nobody may act upon him. Alternatively, the group may describe shared virtues without directly reversing his authority claim.

changed_reading.before: Freedom means that no other individual can stand over or affect him.
changed_reading.after: Rightly formed agency includes chosen reciprocal answerability, where others counsel him and he bears responsibility for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social merit he may count for himself is displaced by mirrored companionship and right-left classification. Standing is not a private hoard that blocks every person; it emerges from response to visible signs and durable affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Counted merits and social honor supply the focus-side status that the closing classification reassigns.
Isolation by individuals contrasts with the later identity of companions belonging to a side.
Companionship and lasting association make standing a shared affiliation rather than solitary prestige.
Right as power and rightful claim reassigns effective standing to an oriented class.
Concealing truth explains how visible grounds of accountability can be actively screened off.
A manifest sign supplies the disclosed criterion that private self-reckoning refuses.
The repeated companionship branch creates a formally matched but opposed collective identity.
The left side supplies the opposed orientation by which the two companion groups are sorted.

structural_cues: 90:18-19 repeat أَصْحَابُ in parallel clauses while changing right to left.
The singular self-estimator of 90:5 ends within plural classes whose standing is relationally named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched affiliations, right-left orientation, concealment, and manifest signs; I infer that these replace self-counted prestige with externally legible standing. The alternative is eschatological grouping with no specific activation of social حسب.

changed_reading.before: His accumulated merit or status insulates him from every separate challenger.
changed_reading.after: His standing is not self-certified: response, affiliation, and orientation place him within a class that can be named and judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final image spatially reverses the denied relation. The man supposes no one can impose constriction عَلَيْهِ; the close presents fire and an emphatically shut enclosure عَلَيْهِمْ over a plural class.

activation_trace.role: Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the focus-side condition that he declares impossible.
Individual isolation is reversed when the supposedly untouchable singular is read toward an enclosed plural class.
Kindled fire supplies the enclosing medium that is now actually over them.
Closing and clamping over something makes the denied constriction spatially explicit.
The split root's second closure inventory reinforces a door sealed with deliberate firmness.

structural_cues: The prepositional relation shifts from عَلَيْهِ in 90:5 to عَلَيْهِمْ in 90:20.
The singular أَحَدٌ in the denied claim is answered by a plural pronominal group under enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, double-resolved closure imagery, and the repeated عَلَى relation; I infer that the final scene answers the earlier boast by literalizing imposed enclosure. The alternative treats the close as consequence without making it a deliberate lexical reversal of يقدر.

changed_reading.before: No one can ever close in upon him.
changed_reading.after: The relation he declares impossible returns at the close as a sealed condition over the class to which such self-reckoning leads.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cushion branch is nominal and remote from the ordinary verb يَحْسَبُ. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially activated by layered wealth; render it only as a metaphor for social insulation, never as the lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ح س ب contains a branch of cushioning and propping, while the denied power remains attached to عَلَيْهِ.

activation_trace.role: A cushion or prop supplies the material image of a self protected from pressure.
Effective control supplies the pressure that his imagined padding is meant to absorb.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material from which social insulation is built.
Matter felted layer over layer turns the wealth heap into figurative padding around the self.

changed_reading.before: His confidence is a purely mental error.
changed_reading.after: His piled wealth acts in his imagination like cushioning that props him up and absorbs every attempt to press power upon him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is highly form-distant: neither يَقْدِرَ nor نَجْعَل carries the cited utensil sense in the local syntax. It remains packet-anchored through the focus cooking-vessel branch and the later feeding emergency; downstream prose should mark it as an imagistic experiment about containment and portioning, not a proposed translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ق د ر includes the cooking vessel and its contents, allowing 'capacity' to flicker as a container with a measured yield.

activation_trace.role: The cooking pot supplies a bounded vessel in which abundance is subjected to measure and transformation.
The cloth used to lower a pot unexpectedly supplies the handling mechanism for the focus vessel image.
Feeding another gives the contained yield a social destination rather than leaving it hoarded.
Famine and exhausting hunger make portioning stored resources materially urgent.

changed_reading.before: No agent can overpower the speaker.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, he imagines himself and his abundance beyond anyone's power to place within measure, transform, and portion into nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The report-reading depends on the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the source root ر ء ي, so it must not replace the direct sense of seeing. It remains valid as a secondary abductive resonance because inquiry is anchored in the focus and public speech surrounds the sight question; render it as reportability supplementing eyewitnessing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch of seeking and testing information can connect effective control to discoverability even when direct sight is denied.

activation_trace.role: Seeking out and testing information supplies investigation as a route past presumed secrecy.
Effective control becomes reachable once information about the act can circulate.
Speech spreading among people supplies a public channel that the boaster cannot fully contain.
The non-dominant mapped branch of narrating reports turns sight into a secondary trace of tellability.

changed_reading.before: If no eye saw the act, no one can reach him.
changed_reading.after: Even absent an eyewitness, inquiry and circulating report can make the act discoverable and therefore answerable.

strongest_changes: The count-measure-one sequence changed brute invulnerability into a fantasy of being unmeasurable and unauditable.
The repeated 90:5 and 90:7 frames made presumed invisibility an abductive basis for presumed non-enforcement.
The obstacle, release, and feeding sequence reversed power from domination resisted into capacity used to remove constraint and answer vulnerable claims.
The final عَلَيْهِمْ with doubled closure imagery spatially answered the earlier denial that anything could be imposed عَلَيْهِ.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained genuinely polyphonic: supposition, accounting, enoughness, status, supervision, effective control, measured limit, constriction, exhaustive anyone, and isolated individuals formed several mechanisms. Context did not collapse them; it repeatedly converted private immunity into audit, boundedness, obligation, reciprocal formation, classification, and enclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: The strongest lexical fork remains whether يَقْدِرَ foregrounds effective mastery, measured delimitation, or constriction; the context sustains all three.
Reading vulnerable persons as claimants عَلَيْهِ requires a reader-supplied move from moral need to binding obligation, though the freeing and feeding sequence supports it.
The cushioning, cooking-vessel, and non-dominant report activations are controlled resonances only and should never displace the local verbal senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Miscalculated power against measured capacity.** Lexical evidence: ح س ب B002 “supposition,” B001 “reckoning,” ق د ر B003 “capacity that reaches effective control,” B001 “measured amount/limit,” ء ح د B002 “negative exhaustive anyone.” Structural cue: the line follows “created in hardship” and precedes the boast about ruined wealth. Assigned role: حسب is faulty mental calculation; قدر is control under limit; أحد stretches the denial across all possible observers/controllers. Abductive move: I infer that the speaker confuses possession or endurance with unlimited capacity. Reading change: the ayah is not only a denial of overpowering; it exposes a bad reckoning of measure, limit, and accountability.

2. **Nobility/accounting overturned by supervision.** Lexical evidence: ح س ب B004 “nobility and counted merits” and B006 “supervision/accountable management”; ق د ر B005 “arranging by estimate.” Structural cue: 90:6 displays wealth as counted merit, while 90:7 repeats “أيحسب” with sight. Assigned role: the same root that can count honor also implies accountability. Abductive move: I supply that his social accounting will be audited by a superior reckoning. Reading change: “أيحسب” begins to sound like an indictment of status-calculation, not just an internal thought.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 90:8–9 answered the denial with furnished faculties, and 90:17’s community of mutual charge showed the kind of accountability he did not reckon with.

baseline.text: Kimsenin ona güç yetiremeyeceğini mi sanıyor?

findings.text: Sanı, kişinin kendi harcamasını ve gücünü sayarken kendisine verilmiş yetileri ve bunların sorumluluğunu hesaba katmadığı kusurlu bir muhasebe olarak açığa çıkar.
Güç yalnız üstün gelme yetisi değildir; insanın kapasitesini sınırına kadar ölçen ve sınırlandıran bir denetimi de içerir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Land is organized by routes, heights, habitations, and dangerous spaces that shape movement and staying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Terrain also reaches graves, mountain hollows, nomadic disorientation, ground-hugging basins, travel gear, and a small attendant boat.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perception turns visible forms into knowledge, protection, warning, or public evidence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation to social circulation, attribution, negotiation, and authoritative formulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become a circulating reputation, an appropriated saying, fabricated authorship, political rule, or an inward doctrine never voiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reputation, Praise, and Ostentation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conduct becomes visible talk, producing either earned praise or performative display.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: good public mention `ش ف ه:B004/m01`; speech circulating among people `ق و ل:B007/m01`; action performed to be seen `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; inherited honor and memorable deeds `ح س ب:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Public standing is produced by a loop between action, visibility, and retelling. Praise records recognized worth, while ostentation tries to manufacture the same outcome by staging the act for observers.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Making moves from measure and design through embodied form to changed state and generated result.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Formation includes inward character, aptitude, generated language, smooth stone, and the persistence implied by "beginning to do."
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measured Design and Creation

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior measuring and design `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; originating creation `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; making or producing `ج ع ل:B001/m01`; bounded measure and term `ق د ر:B001/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material life moves between accumulation, livelihood, feeding, hunger, and the loss of means.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, hospitality revenue, food heaps, relentless demand, animal appetite, and the idiom of possessing neither hair nor felt.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Livelihood, Wage, and Hospitality
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work or productive property yields income that can sustain a household and host others.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: livelihood and hospitality revenue `ط ع م:B004/m01`; wage assigned for work `ج ع ل:B005/m01`; sufficiency and adequate provision `ح س ب:B003/m01`; repeated requests that deplete supplies `ش ف ه:B003/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social and economic obligations persist through trust, debt, guarantee, testament, inheritance, and exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Obligation extends to survivorship gifts, collateral inheritance, delayed payment, ready cash, credit sales, and the "neck" or principal of property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Debt, Term, and Due Penalty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A debt, right, offering, or penalty reaches the point at which it must be discharged.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: debt or right becoming due `ح ل ل:B004/m01`; fixed amount and term `ق د ر:B001/m01`; penalty following an offense `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; final consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Liability matures through time. Measure fixes the obligation, arrival at its term makes it due, and consequence or penalty follows if the claim remains unanswered.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Counting and Reckoning

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Heel, Track, and Pursuing Trace

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tracking reads absence as evidence. Heel marks and trailing dust preserve direction, allowing the observer to reconstruct movement after the quarry has passed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water is found, carried, leaked, surfaced, filtered, and retained through a set of natural and crafted containers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Water appears as a spring, a leaking skin, algae on a surface, a beetle-filled pool, a strainer, a rock basin, and a night journey toward a watering place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Strainer, Vessel, and Residue
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Liquid is poured through a strainer into a vessel, leaving sediment or residue behind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: strainer and receiving vessel `ن ج د:B011/m01`; cooking or liquid vessel `ق د ر:B007/m01`; vessel brim and sides `ص ب ر:B004/m02`; physical sediment residue `ع ق ب:B011/m02`; thickened drink `ك ب د:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Filtration separates flow from remainder. The strainer directs usable liquid into the vessel, its brim marks fullness, and thickness or residue identifies what the filtering process retains.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A caregiver opens a child's mouth and places a measured medicinal substance inside.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cushion, Curtain, and Food Mat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dwelling is furnished with cushions, hangings, and a broad layer placed beneath food.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lunar Mansion and Round Star Cluster
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Celestial objects occupy named stations and are counted or recognized by shape.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lunar mansion and sky void `ب ل د:B004/m01`; round star cluster `ف ك ك:B008/m01`; astronomical reckoning `ح س ب:B001/m02`; opposing star in rising and setting `ر ق ب:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Astronomy organizes the sky through station, opposition, number, and visible shape. A void becomes a mansion because recurring celestial positions make it identifiable.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: First, Sunday, and Calendar Order

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın bir tane, tek ya da eşi olmayan olmasıdır; mutlak kullanımda Tanrı'nın ortağı ve benzeri bulunmadığını bildirir. Sözcüğün yinelenmesi bu tekliği güçlü biçimde vurgular.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı bir tane, tek veya eşi bulunmayan olarak gösterir.
